# mimecast_microsoft_365_directory_integration (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Microsoft 365 directory integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_microsoft_365_directory_integration" "example" {
  description                   = "tf-example-microsoft-365"
  domains                       = ["example.com"]
  tenant_domain                 = "example.onmicrosoft.com"
  server_subtype                = "standard"
  sync_guest_users              = false
  acknowledge_disabled_accounts = true
  enabled                       = true
  max_unlink                    = "100"
  sync_contacts                 = true
  delete_users                  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Integration description.
- `tenant_domain` (String) Microsoft 365 tenant domain.

### Optional

- `acknowledge_disabled_accounts` (Boolean) Whether disabled directory accounts are acknowledged.
- `connector_id` (String) Mimecast Cloud Connector ID.
- `delete_users` (Boolean) Whether users removed from the directory are deleted from Mimecast.
- `domains` (List of String) Domains synchronised by the integration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is enabled.
- `info` (String) Additional integration information.
- `max_unlink` (String) Maximum number of users that one synchronisation may unlink.
- `server_subtype` (String) Microsoft 365 server subtype.
- `sync_contacts` (Boolean) Whether contacts are synchronised.
- `sync_guest_users` (Boolean) Whether Microsoft 365 guest users are synchronised.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Microsoft 365 application client ID returned by Mimecast.
- `id` (String) Mimecast Microsoft 365 directory integration ID.
- `last_sync_date_time` (String) Time of the last directory synchronisation.
- `sync_running` (Boolean) Whether a directory synchronisation is running.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_microsoft_365_directory_integration.example integration-id
```
